description: Get the official SNAP application portal URL for a US state (official_portal_url) with the state agency name and phone from Feed America's state table, plus a Feed America state guide (feedam_state_guide) that links to the official application. Use this when a user asks "how do I apply for SNAP in [state]?". Confirm current details on the official portal.
name: feedam_get_state_snap_portal
